column3: Never! I will never serve you!
Vrooooooooom
Heh.
Whoosh
Hah!
YEAH!
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
HAAAAAA
RAAAAAAHHH!!!
The Banshee Queen schemes threaten the balance. I had no hand in them.
Vol'jin, your soul has walked on the other side and returned. You have been altered more than you know.
You are neither undead nor damned. You do not belong here. Leave this place at once.
Leave now, or stay forever. The choice is yours.
Go now, and do what must be done.
Do not be merciful.
You are prepared for the war to come.
destiny calls to you
There is much to be done.
You are empty inside, just like me.
Be at ease. I am Bolvar Fordragon. These knights and I are here to help.
This is most dire news, we must not let war ravage this plane and unravel all that we have done.
It seems the Jailer has been pulling the strings of fate on our world as well.
Enough! The war is over! We can ill afford to start another!
A far more pressing threat is at hand, and we must prepare to face it.
When the Banshee shattered the helm, it tore a gaming wound through the veil between our world and the Shadowlands.
During my vigil, upon the frozen throne, I caught fleeting glimpses into the realms of death. Among them, I saw a place of inescapable darkness.
That is where you must go, if you are to save those Sylvanas has taken. Together, we can open the way.
Place the shards of domination around the circle of runes then the ritual can begin
When the helm rested upon my head it took all my will to keep its insidious power in check Many times I nearly faltered
I could sense a dark presence at the edge of my consciousness, not Arthas, not Ner'zhul, something else.
It is that very presence I sense lurking beyond the shattered sky above.
I dare not travel with you, even free of the helm. I fear I would become bound to the will of its true master.
But this threat cannot be left unchecked therefore you must venture where I cannot
The dangers you face will be considerable alone you may well be outmatched
To aid in this task, the Knights of the Ebon Blade shall lend you their strength. Darian Mograine has volunteered to fight at your side.
Living mortals were never intended to cross beyond the veil. Where you are going, you may be unable to return.
But there is no other course. Death comes to claim Azeroth. It falls to you to defend her.
The time has come, take up the Shattered Helm and we will open the rift.
The path opens.
As you wish. Champion, please confirm where our acolytes should open the portals.
Of course, there is much to tell. We will talk later, champion.
And when she sundered the helm, the sky above the Citadel shattered. The spire of an immense tower appeared beyond the veil.
Sylvanas Windrunner sent her agents to abduct them, dark winged beings who caught them in chains and dragged them through the shattered sky.
The balance must be restored.
Fight for Azeroth!
Much has been asked. More will be required.
We all have our burdens to bear.
I fear darker days are to come.
The chains of the past still bind us.
We will face whatever comes.
What news?
I will aid you as best I can.
We stand together against the darkness.
There is much to be done.
We all have a duty to fulfill.
You do not understand the risk, Talia. For me to peer into the Maw would... ...would mean.
My shining star, I will do as you request.
Shandris, this may be your only hope of saving Tyrande.
Shandris, I know what it is to bear the scars of war. But this maw walker may be your only hope of saving Tyrande.
It would seem you must brave the horrors of them all once again.
I know not how to locate this missing Maldraxxi Baron, nor our living allies. But I believe I can help you find Darian Mograine. That's a start, at least.
Honored Voice, we seek entrance to the Maw.
We know the risk. There is no choice but to try.
Go carefully champion find Darian and he will age your hunt for the missing Baron
Come at once to Oribos, Maw Walker. I feel a darkness calling to me.
I fear something rises within Torghast. Something... terrible.
Aye, malevolence, crowing, domination, rising!
No, not again.
A weapon forged in the fires of Torghast, a morn blade is born.
There is a price to be paid, for communing with that darkness again, but I must see. We all must know.
Aid me, champion.
The Link has been severed. That is all I can... wait. Something is...
I will not serve you!!
Aaaaaawwwwww!!!
My thanks to all of you, but Jaina is right. The Jailer knows what we saw. He will use that knowledge against us.
Maw Walker, continue your efforts. Explore the dark reaches of Torghast. Fight for the Shadowlands. And when the time comes, we will claim victory!
No, Bane. Though your heart yearns to help save your friends, your body needs to recover.
The attendants here can tend your wounds while the maw walker seeks our allies Stay and tell me what you learned from your time inside the maw
The darkness is all-consuming. I can see only the merest shapes in this lightless void.
Given the chance, the beasts of these halls will hunt down and consume wandering souls. Yours included.
It is difficult to focus here. Its very nature seems ever shifting, wreaking havoc upon my perceptions.
How these Maldraxxi prisoners were taken we cannot know, but they must be freed from their torment.
This is the place I saw when I peered into Torghast. Lady Proudmoore is near.
The souls here are forced to burn smelted into raw material for the jailers vile creations
That is all I can see. It is too dangerous to push further.
Not yet, Calia. There is a price to be paid for such visions. I dare not attempt another so soon.
Please aid them honored voice while I talk with the others We must consider the implications of what we've seen
The Broken Helm still resonates with the power of the Lich King, the power of the Maw.
Together, we can focus our sight deep into the Jailer's realm. But beware, do not lose yourself within the darkness.
And that is all I can see.
I do not know, but we must be cautious, deliberate.
The jailous malevolence permeates everything in that tower. If he believes his prize is in jeopardy, he may decide to... discard it.
What you ask poses a terrible risk to all of us.
I am pleased you are safe, High Chieftain. You need respite. Please sit and bide a moment.
With respect, Lady Proudmoore, you need to recover your strength. Let the maw walker resume the search for the others.
You assisted me in peering into Torghast once, Maw Walker. That bond may forge a link between us as you search the tower.
Each time I gaze into Torghast I sense malevolent eyes staring back. The risk grows ever greater, but we cannot relent.
You must venture into the maw and provoke the wrath of the jailer's eye. His rage will draw out the enemy that holds the key to saving Thrall.
Morwaka, have you lost your way? Ah, a darkness looming.
Beyond God, He senses us.
I have seen a vision of where such vessels are kept, but retrieving it will prove perilous. The Jailer keeps his treasures well guarded.
The Evernblade will help defend the Eternal City.
But this will not be the Jailor's only target.
We will rally the Covenant's forces and make our stand.
The Nathrezim. Serving the Chila. But they were part of the Burning Legion. At least that's what we were led to believe.
The dreadlords are masters of infiltration and illusion. Our covenant forces must remain vigilant.
Stay alert, maw walker. They could be... anywhere.
Sekitar medics, gather your forces. Secure the vault exterior until the maw walker arrives with Tal'galan.
Maw Walker. Polemark Adrestes brings grim tidings from Bastion. You are needed in Oribos at once.
Both Ardenweald and Oribos could come under assault. Darien, the Ebon Blade must protect the city.
I understand Jaina. We depart at once.
I fear we may be too late.
Resist him! Do not let the jailer win!
This magic bound with the Primus is sigil. Is it familiar more Walker?
It is much like the memories you restored to the Runecarver in Torghast. If you bring this to him, perhaps he will know how to untangle the sigil.
This is our only path forward we have no choice but to try
So be it good luck to you both
We are honored to have you among us, Primus. What is our cause now that the Jailer has your sigil?
Of course, Jaina.
Primus, what we witnessed in the Arbiter's chamber, it was beyond mortal understanding.
What will his next move be?
We must launch a counter-attack before the morsworn can strike again.
We will defend Oribos from the Jailor's forces. Hurry Morwaka, the enemy's strength is growing.
Fine work, maw walker.
The covenants await your signal.
Goodbye Talinara, the Abun Blade will defend Oribos until we return.
Good. Then there's no need for introductions. We've come to push back against the Jailer's forces.
The Jailer is gone. Wherever that gateway led, it's been sealed behind him.
As if her power and the sigil were his all along.
My knights will hold her captive here in Oribos. When she awakens, we can begin the interrogation.
For now, we should return to Corvia. Let us hope the Primus can explain the Jailer's plan, and tell us what must be done to stop him.
The compass is imbued with a memory.
By the light, he's expanding the maw around Oribos!
Press the attack! The Jailer must be stopped!
The Banshee is aiming at our heads!
Sylvanas means to claim our heads. Stop her!
Mmm, behind our quarry. Heroes with me!
No! We will stop you!
Jaina, we need a portal.
Your crusade ends here, Banshee.
This time you'll lose, Sylvanas!
Thrall scout ahead. Champions will assist the admiral.
Thrall won't last much longer on his own. We need to reach him.
This power is not yours to command!
We're done with your games, Sylvanas.
No! The Jailer is going to destroy the Arbiter!
Ebon Blade, hold this position!
The Tara group blocks our way. Champions, it is time for the Jailer's pet to meet its end.
Bring down those beasts. You'll need their power to face the Taragru.
Secure the area. Fortify our perimeter.
Lady Proudmoore, we could use your expertise.
Prepare yourselves. The Sanctum of Domination awaits.
We will draw their main forces to us. Champions, find a way to thwart the jailer's plan.
For Azeroth!
We will stop you Sylvanas!
Ebon Blade, secure the portal!
The anima used to empower the jailous forges is being harvested on this floor
Release these souls, champions. Deprive our enemy of his greatest resource.
This is where the pursuit of power leads, a prison of your own making, tormented by memories of failure.
Nezul's cries echoed within the helm when I wore it. There was nobility in him once, before it was twisted into darkness.
Grant him the release of Oblivion Champions.
Hold this portal!
Almost to the summit, be on your guard!
These devices seem to be pulling other realms into the maw, as was done to Korthia.
What else is the jailer looking for?
Knights, secure the chamber.
Kel'Thuzad was one of the Jailor's most obedient lapdogs. I will attempt to twist what remains of his power and open a gateway that takes us straight to his master.
Activating it will take all my focus. Once you're through, you'll need to face whatever's on the other side.
I'll rejoin you as soon as I recover. Together, we'll put an end to the Jailer's threat.
There are no more Falkir to protect you Sylvanas. You will die here... for the last time.
The eye of the jailer is driven out Good and you've gathered valuable information on desmateron But this news of Helia and Vyraz is troubling
I look forward to seeing Maldraxxi forces in action, Arrhenes.
Insidious Banshee!
The Jailer must not take the Eternal City!
The Jailer He who tormented so many Who long ago set in motion the plague of undeath on our world Has finally been destroyed
Do whatever you can to aid the Oracle. The fate of the Shadowlands depends on your success.
I believed I would be trapped in that ice forever, holding the scourge at bay. I thought that was the only path left for me. I dared not hope for anything more.
When the helm was broken, and I was free, I... I was afraid.
A few that the daughter I loved with all my heart would find me and see only a monster.
I won't waste this chance, Talia. I promise you.
The man I was did die that day. The dragon's fire sealed my purpose.
Would you have journeyed to Icecrown if you knew?
Which is why you could not know I Had to make that sacrifice To keep you and the rest of the world safe from that place from that power
I know, and for the pain it caused you, I will always feel sorrow. I pray that one day, you can forgive me for it.
Without the helm of domination to control them, the Scourge roams leaderless. Nothing remains to temper their aggression.
We cannot allow any of them to seize command and unite their forces. The Ebon Blade must remain vigilant.
Icecrown Citadel remains a seat of dark power. We must not let it fall into enemy hands. Perhaps I should return, too.
Darian, thank you. Strange is it not. We both lived lives of service and even after facing death itself, we still feel compelled to serve others.
Anduin, can you tell us anything about the domination that the Jailer put in our way?
If we can find a way to resist domination, it is worth the risk.
Taelia and I will join you. Be prepared, champion. That region is entrenched with powerful Mawsworn.
That feeling in your mind is the quality that makes domination less effective.
Who taught you how to wield a hammer?
Every day.
Look out!
So be it. Let us see what horrors we will have to relive.
We will need to bring the remaining shards of the helm as well.
We must harness what is within us. There is no other choice.
Ready the Shard!
Argh! The burning!
With this reforging, our wills are our own.
We will finish this
We need to know what the Jailer is planning. Darien, take the Covenant forces and make a push from the west.
The Jailer may have sealed the way behind him, but this land is full of mysteries.
There must be another means to enter the Sepulchre. We will not rest until we find it.
Morwaka, we have much to discuss.
I shall deliver the crown of wills to the arbiter then we will bear witness to the fate of Sylvanas Windrunner
Heaven Blade, hold here.
The entrance lies ahead.
Be wary. The defenses protecting the Sepulchre's secrets will be unlike any you have encountered before.
Maasworn are dominating the Atoma. We will hold them here.
Everblade to me! We march to save the king!
The way is open. Prepare yourselves. The Jailer is sending his moss warn against us.
You have begun to unravel the mysteries of Zereth Mortis now, we must put this knowledge to use
I will inform the Primus of your discoveries. His insights will be invaluable.
Yet more remains to be done. Continue to explore this land. Any new information you find may help us turn the tide against the Jailer.
If a new armature is to arise, then there may yet be hope for the Shadowlands. Keep me apprised, Mallwalker.
We cannot allow that to happen.
We are relieved to see you back safe, maw walker.
No, the risk is too great, Uther.
We cannot defeat the Jailer without help from the Enlightened.
Elder Ara, we are in your debt. What do you suggest?
After your flight from the Arbutus Chamber, we defeated the Nathrezim, but they had sabotaged the gateway.
Once the stain of maw magic had been cleansed, the Primus placed the gateway in this chamber.
He trusted that you would find an anchor on the other side to reactivate it, giving us a path to Cerith Mortis.
Now the true work begins to save Anduin and to prevent the Jailer from remaking reality in his dark image.
The maw walker has opened the way. Covenant forces, forward to Xerith Mortis.
Thank you, Elders. With your aid, we pledge to drive the jailer from Xerith Mortis.
Shandris, you and the maw walker infiltrate the east side and see what you can learn.
For years I sat upon the frozen throne, ignorant of its true purpose, using every ounce of my own will to silence the grim whispers of that cursed crown.
I believed I was holding back the scourge, and the devastation they would unleash. But I now question if it was all part of his plan.
that I was unknowingly playing along in his deception.
Yet he failed, thanks to you, you and the countless others who risked everything for our world, and our very survival.
The jailer looked upon mortals and saw only flaws But in the end it was our strength that proved his undoing
Elder Kramp, what is the purpose of those obelisks?
Then we must protect the remaining obelisks. Should we fail this realm and all reality will pay the price.
Lead on, Mallwalker.
So this is Xerath Mortis, the Hidden Heart of the Shadowlands.
